title: The current role of immunotherapy in treating nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
snippet: Immunotherapy has emerged as a cornerstone in the management of both recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma (R/M NPC) and locoregionally advanced NPC (LANPC).
